title: DATA payload v1.0
description: One completed synthetic mobile data session; counters are session totals, not lifetime counters.

sessionId.description: Synthetic session business identity; one final record per session.

networkNodeId.description: Synthetic node serving the whole session in the MVP; handovers are not modeled.

bytesUploaded.description: Successfully transferred user-data bytes from subscriber to network over this session.

bytesDownloaded.description: Successfully transferred user-data bytes from network to subscriber over this session.

durationSeconds.description: Session elapsed time rounded down to whole seconds; zero-byte and subsecond sessions are allowed.
